key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:9456
name: flush_pending_slot_queue
description: Checks three pending-state words and calls the same helper with zero arguments when the first or third is set. When the middle one is set it claims a slot from a helper, records a marker and the pending value in the table at that slot, and then calls a follow-up helper.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:94FA
name: update_stored_state_byte
description: Calls a helper, then compares the byte taken from its argument with a stored state byte. When they differ it saves the new byte, calls a helper with the previously saved value if one is set, and then calls another helper.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:9544
name: retry_level_file_open
description: When the argument's low byte is minus one it releases the stored handle and sets a sentinel. Otherwise it loops: it tries to open the file through a helper, and on failure it shows prompt text through display helpers, switching to a second prompt after five failed attempts, until the open succeeds.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:978A
name: call_another_routine
description: Calls one other routine and returns immediately, with no further work.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:9798
name: load_counted_data_tables
description: Reads a block of entries, then byte arrays and word arrays that each begin with their own count, from a data source. Each value is written into the shared global table area, and the routine ends by calling a helper with the stored handle.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:994A
name: read_xor_decrypt_file_chunks
description: Reads a file in chunks of at most 512 bytes into a freshly allocated buffer, combining each chunk byte by byte with the shared scratch bytes. Returns zero on success; otherwise it clears a status bit, calls the error helpers and returns one.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:9AF0
name: read_editable_text_line
description: Reads keyboard characters into an echoed buffer, erasing the last one on backspace. On Enter it returns the length, empty input returns a minus-one sentinel, a first character that is not a letter returns a minus-two sentinel, and otherwise the text goes to a lookup helper.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:9C68
name: copy_argument_then_check_status
description: Writes a longword from the caller's stack frame into the location held in an address register, then calls a helper. If that helper reports minus one the routine returns minus one; otherwise it calls another helper with the shared buffers and returns the stored status word.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:9C9A
name: call_helper_return_stack_word
description: Calls a helper with the shared buffer and a stack slot, then returns the word the helper stored in that slot.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:9D04
name: fill_paired_buffers_with_byte
description: Copies the low nibble of its argument into both halves of a byte, sets a shared mode value to three, and fills 160 bytes at each of two buffer positions with that byte.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:9D76
name: search_nearest_matching_entry
description: If the indexed flag byte has bit five set, it stores the argument's coordinate pair as the result and returns minus one. Otherwise it scans candidate entries in widening rounds, keeps the closest one that passes the helper tests, and stores its index and coordinates.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:9F20
name: check_box_overlaps_region
description: Given a position and an extent, returns zero when the box lies entirely beyond any one of four stored edge values, and one otherwise.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:A044
name: find_nearest_of_four_points
description: Computes a value for each of four stored point pairs through a helper, keeps the pair with the smallest value, and stores that pair in the shared result slot.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:A200
name: compute_squared_distance_limited
description: Returns the squared distance between two points as a word. It returns a sentinel of all ones when a coordinate difference is 256 or more or when the sum does not fit in sixteen bits.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:A2A4
name: check_region_overlaps_stored_bounds
description: Returns one when the rectangle given by its arguments overlaps the stored bounds and all four stored corner points pass a helper test, otherwise zero. A first argument word equal to 255 fails at once.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:A42A
name: test_point_side_of_segment
description: Compares two cross-product terms built from three points and returns whether the first is less than or equal to the second, which tells on which side of a line the third point falls.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:A470
name: update_bounding_point_pair
description: Derives a candidate point from three points and compares it with the stored pair along the dominant axis. When the candidate lies further out it replaces the stored pair and returns one; otherwise it returns zero.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:A7FA
name: compute_integer_square_root
description: Returns the integer square root of its argument by Newton iteration, with the remainder in the high word of the result. Zero input returns zero.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:A838
name: compute_entry_scratch_address
description: Looks up an entry address from a table indexed by the current selector, combines two bytes read from that entry into a 16-bit value, and stores the result as the scratch address.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:A898
name: read_scratch_byte
description: Calls a helper to update the scratch address, then returns the byte stored at that address.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:A8AC
name: read_entry_flag_byte
description: Calls a helper, then returns the byte at a fixed field of the table entry selected by the argument's index word. Entries are eighteen bytes long.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:A8D6
name: read_entry_byte_when_unflagged
description: Calls a helper only when a flag byte for the argument's index is clear, then returns the byte at a fixed field of that table entry. When the flag is set it returns zero.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:A924
name: store_entry_byte_by_index
description: Calls a helper, then stores the low byte of its argument into a fixed field of the table entry chosen by the argument's high byte. Entries are eighteen bytes long.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:A94C
name: load_entry_corner_points
description: Calls a helper, then reads eight words from the table entry chosen by the argument and stores them as four point pairs in the shared corner globals.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:AA22
name: lookup_range_mapped_value
description: Selects a group of three-byte range records by the argument's high byte, then returns the third byte of the record whose first two bytes bracket the low byte. Returns 255 when no range matches.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:AAD0
name: apply_mode_change_if_nonzero
description: Sets a shared flag to one. When the argument is nonzero it clears that flag if it was set and calls two helpers, then calls one of two helpers depending on whether the argument equals 128.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:AB36
name: reset_row_state_for_mode
description: Clears a 40-byte buffer and resets its pointer. When a shared flag is set and the argument's high byte is nonzero, it zeroes a run of row entries and then dispatches to one of two helpers depending on whether the argument equals minus 128 or minus 127.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:AC84
name: emit_row_span_segments
description: Builds sixteen span records from the table entries of the chosen row. Each pass walks the spans, calls a helper for every column that falls inside the 40-column bounds, and advances the spans between passes.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:AFC6
name: copy_sprite_block_masked
description: When a flag is set it clears a rectangular strip of bytes. Otherwise it computes a clamped top-left position from the table entry and size, copies source bytes into the target buffer row by row, and ANDs clip mask bytes into the edge columns.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:B460
name: shuffle_index_and_draw_cells
description: Fills a 40-entry table with values read through a helper, then shuffles a 50-entry index table by swapping each position with one chosen through a helper. For each of 50 rounds it draws the indexed cells across 40 columns whose entries lie inside the limit.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:B718
name: measure_and_layout_text_line
description: Walks a zero-terminated list of character codes, adding each character's width from a per-character width table. Escape codes of all ones reset or advance the line position, and the resulting extents are stored in the shared position globals.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:B8F6
name: select_indexed_slot_by_key
description: Selects a slot from the shared index table when the argument matches its stored key. A sentinel argument clears the selection; when the chosen value is below 128 it calls helpers and resets the associated state globals.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:B932
name: select_slot_if_key_matches
description: Compares the stored key byte at the indexed position with the argument. On a match it records the selection and calls helpers; otherwise the selection is treated as invalid, and a valid selection below 128 resets the associated state globals.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:B952
name: commit_current_selection_state
description: Records the current selection byte, then calls helpers. When the recorded selection is below 128 it resets the associated state globals.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:B9EC
name: reset_selection_state
description: Reads the value at the currently selected index, clears a counter, sets the selection byte to the reset sentinel and calls a helper.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:BA30
name: run_encoded_sequence_step
description: Steps through an encoded list of entries when a cursor is active and its countdown is zero. An escape code ends the sequence, restarts it or jumps, and ordinary entries call a helper and accumulate extents, with the running maximums updated as they go.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:BCE6
name: reset_selection_sentinel
description: Writes the reset sentinel into one shared byte and zero into another.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:BCF0
name: clear_selection_and_notify
description: Clears a state byte and a counter. If the current selection is below 128 and its table entry matches the cleared byte it calls a helper, then marks the selection as unset and calls another helper.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:BD70
name: reset_extent_pair_from_source
description: Clears a state byte and calls a helper with two stored words. It then copies the second stored pair of extents into the first pair and into the running extremes.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:BDD6
name: fill_or_copy_scanline_span
description: Does nothing unless a helper returns a valid value and the two points differ. It updates the top and bottom bounds of each column covered, then fills the scanline between the points with one constant value, or copies source bytes when the source flag is set.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:C0CC
name: read_word_from_byte_pointer
description: Combines the two bytes at the pointer in its argument into a word, low byte first.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:C0F8
name: format_signed_decimal_text
description: Writes a signed number as decimal characters into the text output pointer, adding a minus sign for negative values and suppressing leading zeros. Digits are produced from the ten-thousands place downward.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:C188
name: copy_text_expanding_escape_codes
description: Copies a zero-terminated text into the output buffer and drops at-sign characters. Escape codes four to seven each call a helper and skip four bytes, and other escape codes are copied through as a pair.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:C1C0
name: copy_text_dispatch_escape_codes
description: Copies a zero-terminated text into the output buffer and drops at-sign characters, sending escape codes through an indirect dispatch. The dispatch target could not be resolved from the executable, so the escape handling is only partly recovered.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:C3EA
name: call_library_with_stored_argument
description: Stores its argument in a shared word, then calls a library function with a fixed set of values and calls a helper when that call returns a nonzero result.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:C438
name: initialize_shared_tables_and_masks
description: Resets shared flag and sentinel bytes, calls helpers, and clears several shared tables, setting the first hundred entries of one to one. It then fills fourteen words with successive single-bit masks, and calls a library setup function with fixed values when a stored value is below 195.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:C5D2
name: initialize_shared_state_defaults
description: Sets default values for many shared tables and scalar globals, clears a block of per-slot records, and sets fixed limits such as 319 for a right edge. It calls helpers for the remaining setup.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:C8EE
name: write_slot_default_record
description: Writes a fixed default record into the table slot given by the argument's low word, filling word and byte fields with default values. When the argument's high word is nonzero it first clears a second group of fields.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:CA32
name: build_slot_data_record
description: For slot numbers below four, frees any block already stored for that slot, allocates a new record, and fills it with a header, a count, and bytes read through a helper. A second block of bytes follows, whose length is the square of that count.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:CC3E
name: setup_four_slot_layout_tables
description: Stores a vertical range from its arguments and fixed rectangle bounds for four slots. It frees the blocks previously stored for each slot and rebuilds them as zero-filled tables, then clears forty columns per slot.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:CF92
name: set_constant_byte_pair
description: Writes two fixed constant byte values, 77 and 151, into shared globals.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:CFAA
name: repeat_byte_doubling_eight_times
description: Runs eight rounds of a byte shift-and-carry update on a shared byte, then calls a helper with the argument's second byte.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:D05A
name: multiply_and_concatenate_result
description: Multiplies the low byte of its argument plus one by a byte from the high word, then returns the product as a 32-bit value with its low word shifted down by eight bits.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:D074
name: for_each_matching_slot_index
description: Loops over slot indices one to twelve and calls a helper for each index whose stored value equals the current shared byte.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:D0B0
name: sort_matching_slots_by_measure
description: Collects the indices from one to twelve whose stored value matches the shared byte and sorts them so that larger stored measures come first. For each sorted index that is nonzero it computes offsets from the shared position and calls a helper.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:D24C
name: read_flag_bits_after_setup
description: Calls a helper with a stored word, saves two stored words into a slot, and reads a byte through a helper. It then reads a second word and returns it with only its low three bits kept, calling a helper again when those bits are set.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:D380
name: update_slot_entry_state
description: Updates a slot's stored value pair and active flag. When the slot is the selected one and its previous value differs, it calls a helper first, and it sets a dirty flag when the slot is the special index.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:D496
name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls a helper and returns immediately, with no other work.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:D4A2
name: call_helper_on_matching_word
description: Compares a shared word with a word stored at an offset from an address register, and calls a helper when they match.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:D4BA
name: claim_free_slot_for_id
description: When enabled and the given slot is not yet assigned, finds the first free entry in a fourteen-entry table and stores the argument's high byte there. It calls helpers, increments a counter indexed by that value, and sets the slot's state bytes.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:D5E8
name: release_slot_owner_entry
description: Decrements the use count of the slot's current owner and clears the slot's state bytes. When the owner's remaining count is nonzero it calls a helper, then scans the fourteen-entry table for this slot and clears or reassigns the matching entry.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:D73E
name: initialize_slot_pattern_table
description: Marks a slot active and stores its argument. Resets a sixteen-row table of words to all ones, then fills sixteen bytes so each holds its index in both nibbles, and writes two marker bytes, 85 and 255, at the table start when the shared mode is four.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:D822
name: reset_slot_pattern_table
description: Resets a sixteen-row table of words to all ones and fills sixteen bytes so that each holds its index in both nibbles. When the shared mode is four it writes two marker bytes, 85 and 255, at the start of the table.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:D928
name: draw_packed_nibble_rows_clipped
description: Unpacks rows of run-length coded four-bit pixels into a target buffer, one nibble per step. Pixels outside the clip limit or flagged in the mask table are skipped, and the high or low nibble is written depending on the parity of the starting offset.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:DAA4
name: draw_packed_nibble_rows
description: Unpacks rows of run-length coded four-bit pixels into a target buffer, one nibble per step. Pixels outside the clip limit are skipped, and it is the unmasked variant of its sibling routine.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:DBAC
name: adjust_scroll_position_toward_target
description: Aligns the horizontal position to a multiple of eight, then moves it toward the stored target one step of eight at a time. When the mode flag is set it jumps straight to the limit instead, and the target is kept within the configured range.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:DD6C
name: clamp_scroll_and_derive_columns
description: Clamps the horizontal scroll position into a range that starts at 160 and ends 160 short of the stored width in units of eight. It then derives the first and last column indices from the position by subtracting 20 and adding 19.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:DDD2
name: set_scroll_target_with_jump
description: Sets the scroll target to the argument. When the current position is more than 160 away from it, the position jumps directly to the target, and the result is then clamped into the stored range.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:DDF0
name: apply_scroll_target_clamped
description: Jumps the current scroll position to the given target when it lies more than 160 away, records the target, and clamps the position into the stored range.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:DE42
name: redraw_columns_for_scroll_step
description: Compares the stored position with the previous one. A step of eight in either direction redraws a single strip of columns, while a larger change redraws all forty columns, refreshing marked columns first when the flag is set.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:DF18
name: locate_record_entry_for_slot
description: Marks a slot's entry as active, locates its record inside a table using two offsets stored in the table header, and sets the source pointer for that record before calling two helpers.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:E04C
name: update_column_extent_bounds
description: Updates the stored top and bottom extents of one column with the new value, sets the write pointers for that column's buffers, and calls a helper.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:E1F0
name: copy_or_offset_column_buffer
description: When the slot is active and the scroll position moved by something other than eight, copies a forty-row column buffer into the next buffer, adding seventeen to each byte. For single-step moves it writes a repeated-nibble constant word instead.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:E35E
name: decode_rle_nibble_rows
description: Decodes run-length coded packed nibble data into a target buffer, one block at a time. Each code repeats a nibble or copies a literal run, and the output steps by the row length between rows.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:E4FE
name: decode_rle_bytes_into_column
description: Unpacks run-length coded bytes into a column buffer with a stride of forty bytes. Negative codes repeat the next byte and positive codes copy that many literal bytes, stopping when the requested count is used up.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:E55A
name: gather_indexed_table_bytes
description: Copies entries within a byte table, replacing each position from one to the given count with the entry its stored index points to.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:E5A8
name: find_matching_table_entry
description: Selects a group of fourteen entries from the high bits of its argument, then returns the first entry whose flag bits are set and whose stored bounds include the argument's second word. Returns zero when none match.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:E64A
name: scan_next_matching_entry
description: Advances through up to thirteen entries and returns the first one whose flag bits intersect the given mask, which is not marked with the top bit, and whose stored value equals the argument word. Returns zero when none match.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:E656
name: find_region_containing_point
description: Searches a set of linked regions for one whose extent contains the point held in the shared position variables, with coordinates scaled down by eight. It returns the word stored for that region, or zero when no region contains the point.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:E670
name: locate_region_by_point
description: Searches linked regions for the one whose extent contains the point held in the shared position variables, scaled down by eight, and returns its stored word. Returns zero when no region contains the point.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:E67C
name: search_regions_for_point
description: Loops over region chains in order and returns the stored word of the first region whose extent contains the point in the shared position variables, scaled down by eight. Returns zero when the search runs past the last index.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:E7AC
name: scan_regions_for_point_forward
description: Advances through regions from the current index and returns the stored word of the first region whose extent contains the point in the shared position variables, scaled down by eight. Returns zero when no region qualifies.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:E7AE
name: find_region_for_point_chain
description: Walks chains of region entries looking for one whose extent contains the point held in the shared position variables, scaled down by eight. Returns the stored word of the first match, or zero.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:E7F4
name: walk_chain_and_release_links
description: Walks chains of linked table entries from each shared index, calls a helper at the end of each chain that reaches a zero link, and clears the count when finished.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:E8CA
name: process_nonzero_entries_then_clear
description: Loops over the count of entries in a table, calling a helper for each entry that is nonzero, and clears the count afterwards.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:E916
name: emit_visible_column_entries
description: For each entry in a range of columns that lies inside the stored bounds, computes a pointer from a table and a column offset, marks the entry, and calls helpers to emit it.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:EAEA
name: draw_slot_record_columns
description: For a slot with a valid index, walks the record's column entries that fall within the forty-column bounds and calls a helper for each. It then adds the record's column count and height to the slot's stored extents.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:ECBC
name: replace_slot_block_from_source
description: Looks up a source address in a table and reads its length through a helper. It frees any block already held by the slot, allocates a new block tagged with a type of four and the slot number, and copies the source bytes into it after a small header.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:EDC6
name: copy_bytes_into_pending_block
description: Copies bytes from the shared source buffer into the pending block, starting at its fourth byte, until the counter reaches the limit.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:EDF0
name: forward_argument_to_helper
description: Passes its argument straight to a helper and returns.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:EE04
name: run_two_pass_setup_check
description: Runs two passes of a helper and returns early whenever a pass reports a nonzero status. If both passes fail it calls helpers with a fixed argument pair and returns the final status, and the routine's text reports that memory ran out and that the disk should be booted.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:EEB6
name: release_highest_priority_entry
description: Finds the entry with the largest status byte among entries one to ninety-nine that hold a pointer and pass a status test. It clears that entry, passes its pointer to a helper, and returns whether an entry was found.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:EF88
name: release_first_eligible_entry
description: Scans up to 129 entries for the first one with a stored pointer and an acceptable status byte that is not the index held in a fixed shared word. It clears that entry, passes its pointer to a helper, and returns one, or zero when none qualifies.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:F028
name: release_first_idle_entry
description: Scans up to eighty-four table entries for one with a stored pointer whose status byte is zero, ignoring the top bit when the shared flag is set. It clears that entry, passes its pointer to a helper, and returns one, or zero when none qualifies.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:F0BC
name: find_and_release_pending_entry
description: Scans up to 139 table entries for one whose stored pointer is set and whose status byte passes the checks. It clears that entry, passes its pointer to a helper, and returns one, or zero when no entry qualifies.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:F144
name: cycle_through_four_states
description: Steps a shared state counter through states zero to three, calling a helper for each state, and returns one or zero depending on whether the counter wrapped to a nonzero value.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:F1E8
name: register_record_pointers_by_type
description: Walks records laid out by their own length fields and stores each record's address in a slot table indexed by its third byte, for record types one to six. Other record types call a helper.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:F21E
name: fix_record_pointers_by_type
description: Walks linked records by their length fields and stores each record's address or value in a slot table indexed by its third byte, for record types two to six. Type one jumps back to the start of the walk, and other types call an error routine that reports a bad allocation type.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:F334
name: trace_unresolved_external_entry
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code was recovered for this routine. The listed facts show 46 instructions, two calling routines, and that it was reached during the reference run from outside the static flow.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:F3DC
name: copy_longwords_until_count_ends
description: Copies 4-byte words from a source pointer to a destination pointer, stepping both by one word each time, until the remaining length counter is no longer positive.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:F40E
name: rearrange_block_list_below_limit
description: Walks a linked list of blocks up to a limit address, using helper calls to rearrange each block and to update its size and link fields. Returns the last block visited.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:F4D8
name: allocate_from_free_list
description: Walks the free list, building each block from the stored size table through a helper and stopping when a block fails to build. It then returns the first free block at least as large as the requested size, and reports when no further free list entries exist.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:F5E2
name: return_block_to_free_list
description: Rounds the requested size up to a multiple of eight with a minimum of eight, finds the insertion point in the size-sorted free list, and passes the block to a helper that links it in.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:F65A
name: insert_and_merge_free_block
description: Inserts a block into the address-sorted free list, then merges it with the following block when they touch and with the preceding block when they touch.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:F72C
name: initialize_memory_pool_blocks
description: Calls helpers with fixed values of 20000 and 30000, then probes for the largest available block sizes from 262144 downward, up to ten blocks. The blocks found are sorted by size and linked into the free list.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:FA64
name: release_pool_block_list
description: Calls a helper with each entry of the free-block list, and calls it again with the pending block when that block is set.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:FAC8
name: return_status_after_refresh
description: Calls a helper to refresh state, then returns the shared status word.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:FAE2
name: poll_until_status_nonzero
description: Calls helpers in a loop, reading a status value on each pass, and stops when the status becomes nonzero. It then calls a final helper.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:FB20
name: handle_sound_toggle_event
description: Handles an input event code: the sound-toggle code flips a state flag and redraws the Sounds Off or Sounds On label, and other matched codes trigger helper actions. Unmatched codes are stored as the pending event.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:FD3C
name: increment_busy_counter
description: Increments a shared busy counter, and when it changes from zero it sets a shared flag and calls a helper.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:FD62
name: decrement_busy_counter
description: Decrements a shared busy counter. When it drops to zero or below it resets the counter, clears a shared flag and calls a helper.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:FD8A
name: call_helper_with_table_entry
description: Looks up a table entry from the high word of its argument and calls a helper with the shared base and that entry's offset plus four.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:FDBC
name: layout_centered_label_text
description: Lays out a label by summing the width of each character from a width table to center it. It clears a buffer and fills its markers with all ones, writes each character through a helper, then busy-waits until a counter reaches a value derived from the argument.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:FF40
name: compare_recorded_event_with_text
description: When the argument is nonzero it reads a stored character from a fixed table, clears it, calls helpers, and compares it with the last recorded event. Otherwise it goes straight to the common ending, which runs four helper calls.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:1000A
name: delegate_to_helper_routine
description: Calls one helper and returns immediately, with no other work.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:10016
name: loop_while_test_nonzero
description: Calls a test helper, and while it returns nonzero calls a second helper and keeps its result. Returns the last value of that second helper.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:10032
name: wait_for_nonzero_event
description: Calls a helper until it returns a nonzero value, then calls a second helper when that value equals 301 and returns the value.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:10054
name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately. The body contains no calls or work, so it is only an empty routine.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:1005C
name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately. The body contains no calls or work, so it is only an empty routine.

name: call_helper_then_clear_flag
description: Calls a helper, then clears a shared byte to zero.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:10074
name: take_and_clear_pending_word
description: Calls a helper, then returns the shared pending word and resets it to zero.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:10094
name: fetch_pending_word_after_refresh
description: If the shared pending word is zero it calls a helper to refresh it, then returns the word.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:100C0
name: store_nonzero_field_word
description: Stores the argument word into a field eighteen bytes into the record pointed to by the first argument, but only when that word is nonzero.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:100E0
name: dispatch_input_event_to_slot
description: Clears a sixteen-word scratch area, then matches the pending input event against a table of up to ninety-nine entries. Unmatched events below 512 are recorded with state four, while events with the top bit set are resolved by position: inside the active area they look up a target and record state one, and outside it they record state two.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:10284
name: select_slot_data_pointer
description: Sets the current data pointer to the block stored for the slot named by the argument, falling back to the shared base when that block is absent.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:102C4
name: advance_record_cursor_checked
description: When the argument exceeds a stored limit it reads the next step through a helper and advances the record cursor by the step size stored in the record. A sentinel of all ones resets the cursor instead; otherwise the routine calls a helper and returns zero.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:102E4
name: advance_record_cursor
description: Reads the next step through a helper. A sentinel of all ones resets the cursor to the shared base, otherwise the cursor advances by the byte stored sixteen bytes into the record and the step is returned.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:10300
name: skip_record_by_length
description: Advances the cursor by the length byte stored sixteen bytes into the current record.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:10314
name: call_helper_pass_through
description: Calls one helper and returns with no other work.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:1032A
name: find_slot_entry_by_key
description: Searches for the argument key either by scanning backward through the table or forward through up to eighty slots, depending on the current entry's flags. A match stores the slot and its data pointer, returning one or zero depending on the mode, and a sentinel of all ones means nothing matched.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:103A0
name: find_forward_slot_by_key
description: Scans forward through up to eighty slots for the argument key that has a nonzero data pointer. On a match it sets the cursor to that slot and returns zero, and a sentinel of all ones means no slot matched.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:103AE
name: find_backward_slot_by_key
description: Scans backward from the current index for the argument key. On a match it records the slot and its data pointer and returns one, and a sentinel of all ones means no slot matched.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:103BA
name: scan_back_for_slot_key
description: Scans backward from the given index down to one for the argument key. On a match it records the slot and its data pointer and returns one, and a sentinel of all ones means no slot matched.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:10410
name: scan_back_before_slot_key
description: Scans backward from the slot before the current index for the argument key. On a match it sets the data pointer and records the slot, returning one, and a sentinel of all ones means no slot matched.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:1041E
name: queue_pending_slot_entry
description: Clears a sixteen-word scratch area, then unless a flagged entry already covers the current slot, stores the slot's pending values, decrements the slot count and marks the slot. It calls a helper when the shared flag is set.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:10594
name: resolve_slot_lookup_result
description: Calls a lookup helper and returns its result, except when the argument is above a stored limit. In that case the lookup status decides between a sentinel of all ones, the result of a second helper, and zero after a third helper call.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:105B8
name: resolve_lookup_status
description: Calls a lookup helper and returns a sentinel of all ones when its status is all ones, the result of a second helper when the status is zero, and otherwise zero after a third helper call.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:105CE
name: call_helper_when_index_zero
description: Calls a helper and returns its result when the index register is zero. Otherwise it calls a different helper and returns zero.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:105E2
name: call_helper_return_zero
description: Calls a helper and returns zero.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:105F4
name: load_record_state_and_refresh
description: Masks a state byte with three, calls a helper with the value stored for that slot, and copies the shared pending pair into the saved position globals.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:10658
name: select_entry_if_matches_current
description: Compares the stored byte at the argument's index with the shared selector. On a match it copies the word stored for that index into two shared position variables and returns zero; otherwise it returns a sentinel of all ones.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:10682
name: copy_indexed_word_to_position
description: Copies the word stored at the index held in its argument register into two shared position variables and returns zero.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:106AE
name: update_active_entry_from_event
description: When a current selection is active, updates the matching entry from the event's flag bits. It clears the entry's stored word when the high bits equal one, and calls helpers when the entry's record lacks its marker byte or the low bits change.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:107E4
name: apply_bitmask_entry_updates
description: Walks the sixteen bits of a mask read from a record. For each set bit it updates a pending word from the record's entries: some bits clear the slot, some combine values through a table, and the rest store a byte with an optional top-bit flag.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:109E8
name: clear_mismatched_slot_bits
description: For each of sixteen slots whose value is not minus one and whose low two bits differ from the argument's low byte, calls a helper with that slot's bit mask. It then stores the argument's low byte at the shared index.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:10A80
name: tick_countdown_and_reset
description: When the shared index is nonzero, decrements a countdown byte and resets a companion byte to the sentinel. It calls three helpers, then bumps the countdown when its low bit is set.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:10B24
name: initialize_record_cursor_state
description: Loads the record pointer for the selected slot, clears two cursor offsets, and sets cursor flags from bits in the record. It calls helpers and loops over sixteen slots, calling a helper for each active one before accumulating a shared total.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:10C70
name: step_path_cursor_and_emit
description: Advances a cursor through a sequence of path records. It reads step offsets from the record, updates the running position, and stops at a terminator or turn marker, storing the resulting cursor index.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:10ED8
name: load_sixteen_words_from_bank
description: Copies sixteen words from the table bank selected by the shared index, each block thirty-two bytes apart, into the shared working table.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:10F98
name: store_sixteen_words_to_bank
description: Copies the sixteen words of the shared working table back into the table bank at the selected index, each block thirty-two bytes apart.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:11058
name: expand_nibble_palette_entries
description: Stores values into a sixteen-entry table derived from a record. When a flag bit is clear it fills the entries with fixed default values, otherwise it splits each stored byte into its low and high nibbles across the entries.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:11134
name: compute_sprite_column_coverage
description: Derives a sprite's horizontal and vertical extent from its record and the current offsets, marks the columns it covers in a bitmask table, and clips against the screen limits. It returns one when the sprite is on screen and zero when it lies outside.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:11598
name: decode_nibble_run_counts
description: Reads run-length coded nibbles from the source pointer one run at a time, decrementing the count argument as each run finishes. It returns the high nibble of the last code read once the count reaches zero.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:11614
name: flag_columns_with_set_bits
description: Scans forty columns of a mask table and, for each set bit within the lower fourteen bits, flags the matching slot entry as one.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:11672
name: composite_column_bits_into_buffers
description: For each of forty columns, walks the set bits of its mask and, for each valid bit, updates the column's minimum and maximum extents, toggles its bit, and copies or clears that column's bytes in the output buffer. It finishes by clearing fourteen shared bytes.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:1180C
name: load_record_header_and_words
description: Loads one record at the index given by its argument, with each record thirty-eight bytes long. It copies four header bytes into the shared bytes, then reads sixteen big-endian words from the record into a shared table.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:118C8
name: write_record_bytes_and_columns
description: Writes up to two byte fields of the record selected by its first argument, skipping values equal to minus 32768. When its third field is not that sentinel it copies sixteen column pairs from the stored data into the record.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:119B4
name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately. The body contains no calls or work, so it is only an empty routine.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:119BC
name: draw_palette_entry_via_library
description: Rotates a four-entry index through a table, splits the selected 16-bit entry into three nibble fields, and calls a library function twice with those fields and a fixed value of 17, once for each of two bases.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:11AD2
name: read_two_words_from_block
description: Copies two words from a fixed block of the shared state into the two output words given by its arguments.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:11AFE
name: call_another_routine
description: Calls one other routine and returns immediately, with no further work.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:11B0C
name: return_and_clear_shared_word
description: Returns the current value of a shared word and sets that word to zero.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:11B26
name: return_and_clear_second_word
description: Returns the current value of a second shared word and sets that word to zero.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:11B40
name: set_pair_flags_from_event
description: Ignores event codes 232 and 233. For event 104 it sets the flag at offset twenty to one and clears the flag at offset twenty-two; for event 105 it does the reverse.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:11B86
name: create_library_surface_pair
description: Requests a library resource with fixed arguments of 144 and 65538, stores its handle, and calls a library function twice with fixed sizes of 16 and offsets of minus seven.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:11BFA
name: refresh_library_surface_pair
description: Calls a library function once for each of two bases, using the stored handle plus 72 and a size of 144.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:11C30
name: reset_library_surface_offsets
description: Calls a library function twice, once for each base, with sizes of 16 by 16 and zero offsets, using the stored handle plus 72.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:11C84
name: position_library_surface_pair
description: Calls a library function twice, once for each base, with sizes of 16 by 16 and offsets derived from a shared byte: its negated value plus one and its negated value.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:11D04
name: branch_on_shared_byte
description: Calls one helper when the shared byte is zero or negative, and a second helper otherwise.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:11D1E
name: fill_nibble_rectangle_pattern
description: Clips a rectangle to the 320 by 200 screen area and to the stored column limits, then writes a repeated nibble pattern into its columns. The edge nibbles of the first and last columns are kept.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:11D42
name: fill_nibble_rectangle_from_stack
description: Clips the rectangle held in its stack frame to the screen area, then writes a repeated nibble pattern into each row and masks the edge nibbles.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:11D8C
name: fill_nibble_rectangle_rows
description: Clips a rectangle to the screen area and the column limits, then fills its rows with a repeated nibble value, masking the edge nibbles when the flags are set.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:11DA4
name: fill_rows_with_nibble_value
description: Writes a nibble-repeated value into each row of a clipped rectangle, masking the edge nibbles when the flags are set. The clip values are applied before the row loop starts.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:11E68
name: update_extents_and_fill_rows
description: Updates the column extents for a range of columns, then fills rows of the rectangle with repeated bytes and masks the edges, following the same pattern as its neighbouring routines.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:11F6E
name: fill_rectangle_row_loop
description: Fills the rows of a rectangle from the stored row position up to the stored limit, writing the byte pattern into each row and masking the edges when flags are set.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:11FF8
name: find_region_index_for_value
description: Returns the index of the first of three ranges that contains the argument word, using each range's base and width. Returns minus one when none matches, and three when a shared flag is set.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:12070
name: set_shared_byte_to_constant
description: Sets a shared byte to the constant 82.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:12080
name: publish_byte_and_set_flag
description: Copies a shared byte into a shared word, calls a helper, and then sets a shared byte to one.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:120A8
name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately. The body contains no calls or work, so it is only an empty routine.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:120B0
name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately. The body contains no calls or work, so it is only an empty routine.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:120B8
name: offset_buffers_and_clear_table
description: When the shared flag is set, adds seventeen to every byte in three buffers sized by their counts. It then clears a 40-entry table by writing zero into each entry.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:1221A
name: clear_hundred_entries_then_call
description: Calls a helper with zero one hundred times, then calls a second helper once.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:12240
name: update_entry_by_kind
description: Applies a stored entry according to its kind. Kind one calls a helper with the entry's word, while other kinds record the entry's values and state, call helpers and update the slot's word fields.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:124A2
name: release_slot_when_set
description: When the slot's stored word is not minus one, calls a helper with the slot's stored words, clears the state byte, and resets the slot to minus one.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:1252A
name: find_entry_containing_point_range
description: When the point lies outside a stored vertical range, scans entries from the top down for a flagged one whose bounds contain the point. It returns that index, or zero when none matches.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:125FA
name: switch_active_slot_state
description: When the requested value differs from the shared state, calls helpers to mark the old state inactive and the new one active, then stores the new state.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:12664
name: find_index_matching_byte
description: Scans entries one to ninety-nine for one whose stored byte matches the argument, and returns its index, or zero when none matches.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:126A6
name: find_index_matching_pair
description: Scans entries one to ninety-nine for the first whose stored byte equals both values in the argument frame, and returns that index, or zero when none matches.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:126B6
name: clear_slot_state_and_notify
description: When the given slot is nonzero, clears its two state bytes and calls a helper. If the slot's state is still zero it calls two helpers, then clears the slot's flag.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:126C4
name: clear_frame_slot_state
description: Clears two state bytes for the slot named in its frame and calls a helper. When the state is still zero it calls two helpers, and it finishes by clearing the slot's flag.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:1272E
name: decrement_slot_count_and_notify
description: Decrements the count stored for the slot named by the argument's high word, then calls a helper with a value of all ones.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:1275A
name: remove_entry_from_active_lists
description: Clears the two shared references that point to the given entry and sets a shared flag. It calls a helper, then removes the entry from the active list, decrementing the owner's count for each match.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:127AC
name: remove_entry_from_list_entries
description: Walks the list of active entries and, for each one that matches the argument, marks it as free and decrements the count for the argument's owner.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:127F0
name: reset_active_entry_flags
description: Sets a shared flag and calls a helper, sets both shared references to minus one, and clears a counter. It keeps only the top bit of eighty-five flag bytes.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:1283A
name: read_shared_status_word
description: Returns the value of a shared status word.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:12848
name: pass_shared_word_to_helper
description: Passes a shared word to a helper and returns.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:1285E
name: call_another_routine
description: Calls one other routine and returns immediately.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:1286C
name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately. The body contains no calls or work, so it is only an empty routine.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:12874
name: append_entry_if_room
description: When the shared flag is clear and fewer than ten entries are stored, appends the argument's high byte to the entry list and increments the count for that entry's slot.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:128BC
name: clear_matching_entries_then_reset
description: Finds the first index from one to twelve whose stored byte equals the shared value and returns early if none matches. Otherwise it sets the shared value to the sentinel, calls a helper, and clears thirteen entries.
